description: The buzz meter for one coin: how much the public communities we monitor talk about it against its own normal day (0-100, 50 = a normal day), mentions in 24 hours and 7 days, mentions a day, and whether it is talked about more than its price moved. Counts only: no message text and no names. status=not_enough_data under 10 mentions in 7 days. No key. From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.

symbol.description: coin ticker, name or dashboard slug, e.g. SOL, Pepe, Chainlink
